## Pensieve 0.5.1

> *"I use the Pensieve. One simply siphons the excess thoughts from one's mind, pours them into the basin, and examines them at one's leisure."*
> — Albus Dumbledore, *Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire*

The AI research notebook that keeps up with you: think out loud and get organized, read papers in your own language, never miss new work, and plan a day you can actually do — on your computer and your phone.

**Free · Works locally · Collects no data · No account.** Your notes live on your own computer; every paired device keeps a full copy that works offline. No Pensieve cloud, no analytics, no tracking. AI requests go straight to the AI service you choose, with your own key.

### Download

| Your system | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 / 11 | **Pensieve-Setup-0.5.1.exe** |
| Mac with Apple Silicon (M1–M4) | **Pensieve-0.5.1-mac-arm64.zip** |
| Mac with Intel | **Pensieve-0.5.1-mac-x64.zip** |
| Linux (64-bit) | **Pensieve-0.5.1-linux-x86_64.AppImage** or **Pensieve-0.5.1-linux-amd64.deb** |
| Android 8+ (HarmonyOS via 卓易通) | **Pensieve-0.5.1-android.apk** |
| iPhone / iPad (iOS 15+) | **Pensieve-0.5.1-ios-unsigned.ipa** — install with Sideloadly or AltStore ([how](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install)) |

Install it first on the computer you keep running — it is the hub your phone syncs with. Then add an AI model key (Settings → AI models) and pair your phone (Settings → Sync → Pair a phone). Tour and guide: **[photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/)**

First start: Windows SmartScreen → *More info → Run anyway*. macOS → *System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway* (not notarized yet). Linux → `chmod +x` the AppImage, or `sudo apt install ./Pensieve-0.5.1-linux-amd64.deb`.

### iPhone and iPad

**Pensieve-0.5.1-ios-unsigned.ipa** is an unsigned arm64 device build for iOS / iPadOS 15+. Use Sideloadly or AltStore on a computer to sign it with your own Apple ID and install it — Safari cannot install the IPA directly. Free Apple ID signing normally needs refreshing every seven days. This is not an App Store or TestFlight release. See the [installation instructions / 中文安装步骤](https://photonghost308.github.io/pensieve-app/#ios-install).

iPhone / iPad 安装包（iOS 15 及以上）：下载 IPA，通过电脑上的 Sideloadly 或 AltStore 自签安装，不能直接在手机浏览器点击安装。免费 Apple ID 通常每 7 天需刷新签名。录音时保持应用在前台。本版尚未经过实体 iPhone 测试。

The device and simulator builds are checked by GitHub Actions; testing on a physical iPhone is still to come. The simulator ZIP (**Pensieve-0.5.1-ios-simulator.zip**) is for Xcode developers only and cannot be installed on an iPhone.

### What's in it
- 🎙 **Think out loud, get organized** — with the cursor in a note, your words are tidied and typed there; with no cursor, they become an idea, to-dos and calendar entries. *Fix a name* corrects a misheard name everywhere and remembers it.
- 📄 **Read papers in your language** — translations follow the paper's paragraphs with the key sentences in **bold**; original abstracts translated with one click; the reader remembers where you were.
- 🔎 **Never miss new work** — AI searches arXiv and OpenAlex, rates each paper against your project, and a daily push brings the newest ones (dated, never twice).
- 🗓 **Plan around what is fixed** — calendar, main line of the day, deadlines, and reminders that reach your phone.
- 📬 **Email that tells you what it needs**, 📝 **pages with AI conversations**, **Notion and Obsidian import**, **Zotero / EndNote** libraries, 💻 **Codex, Git and terminals** on the desktop.

### New in 0.5.1
- **Email on your phone, even without the computer.** Set an account up on the phone too (Settings → Email → *Use on this phone too*, or add it there while the computer is away): its password stays on the phone, encrypted with the phone's own secure key store (Android Keystore / iOS Keychain). When the computer can't be reached, the phone **checks your mail itself** (nothing is marked read), analyses it with the phone's own AI, **sends replies and new mail** (a copy goes to your Sent folder, the answered mail is flagged as answered), marks mail read or unread, and opens bodies and attachments. With the computer back, it takes over again.
- **Everything you do on the phone shows up on the computer — and the other way round.** Replied, read, done, *Not important*: they sync both ways, and a mail the phone fetched is never doubled when the computer fetches it too (the computer just keeps its own copy of the files). New: a **Not important** button on every mail takes it out of *Needs attention* and *To reply*, and is remembered for the sender.
- **Timetable photos on the phone.** A photo of your timetable is read on the phone too when the computer is away — with the computer's vision model copied to the phone, or your SiliconFlow (硅基流动) key on the phone (Qwen3-VL), or an OpenAI / Zhipu / Bailian key.
- **Balance on the phone.** Settings → Usage & balance on the phone shows the computer's estimate while it is away (less what the phone has spent since — speech-to-text included), and you can **enter a balance on the phone** (for SiliconFlow and others without a balance API); it is handed to the computer when the phone next reaches it.

### New in 0.5.0
- Update checks work behind a VPN or campus network (GitHub's hourly limit no longer matters); Android updates never cost the phone's data (one signing key, mismatched files refused); the paper-library options in Settings show their text again.

### New in 0.4.9
- Import your **timetable** (photo, PDF, Excel, Word, .ics) with exact times, classrooms and exams; **paper-reader highlights** that cover exactly the text, with ⌘Z undo and colour changes; **Pensieve updates itself**; the **idea library by project** with connections across projects; **Zotero / EndNote / Mendeley** import; **Notion and Obsidian** with H4 headings, links to headings and attachments; formulas at the right size; your own **phone bottom bar**.

Checksums: `SHA256SUMS.txt` (desktop and Android) and `ios-SHA256SUMS.txt` (the iOS IPA).

Pensieve is designed by **Tianyi Xu** — [photontec.github.io](https://photontec.github.io/#about-me).
